confidence_rationale: This is the sharpest and most precisely-targeted counterweight in the pull, and it lands on SD-031's structure rather than on its periphery. The authors draw a distinction REE has not explicitly made: NARROW sense of agency (associated with movements) versus BROAD sense of agency (associated with environmental events). They then argue that the comparator model was developed from, and is evidentially supported by, studies of sensory consequences NARROWLY tied to movements -- while standard experimental paradigms in fact study only BROAD agency. Their conclusion is that the comparator model is not a satisfactory account of sense of agency, that narrow SoA is equally well explained by a simpler motor-signal model, and they report two experiments that failed to induce illusory narrow SoA where the comparator model predicts it should be inducible. This matters for SD-031 specifically because z_world is by definition the BROAD stream -- environmental consequences, 'the door opened because of me' -- and SD-031 proposes to apply a comparator architecture precisely there, which is the extension these authors argue is unwarranted. Confidence 0.69: peer-reviewed, argument is directly on point, and it is the exact structural objection SD-031 must answer; discounted because it is primarily a theoretical/negative-result paper whose empirical component is two null illusion-induction experiments (informative but limited), and because an argument against a comparator as a model of conscious AGENCY EXPERIENCE is not automatically an argument against a comparator as a functional attribution MECHANISM.
failure_signatures: The comparator model's evidential support comes from narrow (movement-tied) sensory consequences, but it is routinely applied to broad (environmental-event) agency, where that support does not extend.
Two experiments designed to induce illusory narrow sense of agency in healthy participants failed to do so, contrary to comparator-model prediction.
For narrow sense of agency a simpler motor-signal model explains the data equally well, so the comparator's extra machinery is not licensed by parsimony.
Conflating narrow and broad agency lets a model validated on one be credited with explaining the other.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The comparator model is not a satisfactory model of sense of agency. Most studies neglect the distinction between narrow SoA (tied to movements) and broad SoA (tied to environmental events); the comparator model emerges from studies of sensory consequences narrowly associated with movements; narrow SoA is explained equally well by a simpler motor-signal model; and standard experimental paradigms study only broad SoA. Two experiments failed to induce illusory narrow SoA where the comparator model predicts it should be possible.
mapping.ree_translation: SD-031 instantiates MECH-256's comparator on the z_world stream, i.e. on precisely the BROAD (environmental-event) domain that Christensen and Grünbaum argue the comparator model was never validated for. Their critique therefore bears directly on SD-031's central design decision rather than on an incidental detail: it says the architectural move of extending a movement-validated comparator to world-state consequences is under-warranted by the human data. It does NOT say a comparator is the wrong engineering solution for REE; it says the biological-analogy argument in SD-031's functional_restatement is weaker than it appears, and that a simpler non-comparator account may suffice.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The decisive caveat, and it materially limits how far this weakens SD-031: Christensen and Grünbaum are arguing about the comparator as a model of the conscious EXPERIENCE of agency in humans, whereas SD-031 specifies a functional attribution MECHANISM in an artificial agent, with no phenomenal commitment whatsoever. A model can be a poor account of what agency FEELS like while remaining a perfectly good way to COMPUTE what an agent caused. So this weakens SD-031's biological-warrant argument, not its engineering validity -- and REE should record it as such rather than as evidence that the comparator will not work. Two further limits: the empirical component is two null illusion-induction experiments (absence of an induced illusion is weak evidence against the underlying mechanism), and their positive proposal (a motor-signal model) is offered for NARROW agency, so they provide no worked alternative for the broad/world-state case that SD-031 actually occupies.
mapping.source_context: Human cognitive neuroscience and philosophy of mind; theoretical review plus two EEG/behavioural experiments in healthy adults attempting to induce illusory narrow sense of agency.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality solid (peer-reviewed, well-argued) but the empirical contribution is two null experiments rather than a positive demonstration. Mapping fidelity high -- the narrow/broad distinction maps almost exactly onto REE's per-stream comparator topology, and z_world is unambiguously the broad stream. Transfer risk is the highest assigned in this pull, and deliberately so: the phenomenal-experience versus functional-mechanism gap is a real disanalogy that caps how much this can weaken an engineering claim. Aggregate reflects a strong structural objection to the biological warrant, not to the design itself.
